collection.title: VW Touareg 2010 to 2016 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The VW Touareg 2010 to 2016 model requires a 26" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Touareg, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
